description: Which scripts/verify-*.mjs and scripts/audit-*.mjs are gates and which are decoration. A wired script must pass; the orphan count may only fall. Scripts that legitimately need a build artifact, a database, or the network are listed in environmentDependent with the reason, and are not executed by the audit. knownFailing records gates that were already failing when this audit was written, each with the reason; the list may only shrink, and a script that starts passing must come off it. The ceiling moved 17 -> 18 once when deleting two dead release workflows orphaned verify-sp-migration-rehearsal.mjs; it is retained rather than deleted because the SP migration routes it rehearses are still live, and it needs a database so it cannot simply be added to the main CI run.

environmentDependent.verify-server-bundle.mjs: Reads dist/ — requires npm run build.
environmentDependent.verify-runtime-dependencies.mjs: Reads esbuild's metafile from dist/ — requires npm run build.
environmentDependent.verify-dependency-audit.mjs: Runs npm audit, which needs registry access.
environmentDependent.verify-ci-disposable-schema.mjs: Provisions and drops a throwaway database.
environmentDependent.verify-sp-migration-rehearsal.mjs: Executes a migration rehearsal against a database.
environmentDependent.verify-database-backup.mjs: Exercises backup and restore against a database.
environmentDependent.verify-memory-stabilization.mjs: Measures runtime memory against a running server.
environmentDependent.audit-coverage-ratchet.mjs: Reads coverage/ — requires a coverage run.
environmentDependent.audit-god-file-boundaries.mjs: Reports reviewed growth allowances as failures; the gate is tests/god-file-boundaries.test.ts, which consults config/ci-ratchet-allowances.json.

knownFailing.verify-phase9-final-i18n-baseline.mjs: NOT stale numbers — a real translation-coverage regression, left failing on purpose so it stays visible. Two modules are declared must-remain-zero and are not: backend-messages has 2 untranslated user-facing literals and supplier-partner has 34. inventory-logistics (1471 > 1381) and sales-pos (783 > 776) also exceed their reviewed caps. The overall total is still under its 12,545 cap, so only the per-module invariants are breached. Raising the caps would erase the finding; the fix is to translate those strings. The gate only runs on manual dispatch of release-verification.yml, which is why nobody saw it.
